svg.aria-label: About Harshavardhan Reddy, AI Engineer at Yukty AI, presented as an AI model card. Boot log: B.Tech CSE in AI and Data Engineering at LPU; AI and Data Engineering intern at Futurense; now AI Engineer at Yukty AI; 45 repos and 390 contributions this year; from Kadapa, India; goal: raw data in, self-running AI out. Capabilities: data pipelines, LLMs and agents, ML and deep learning, APIs, cloud, automation. Running now: Truxlo, social autopilot, JARVIS, AURA, learning generative AI. Benchmarks: 30% faster data processing, 0.41 ROUGE-L, 8 quality gates per post, 25+ AI feeds a week, 0 cloud calls for JARVIS, 40% better fleet tracking.
